messages:
Maya (CSM): Quick weekly check for Orion Analytics — private VPC health + KMS status. Sharing region metrics and action items.
Liam (Onboarding): Thanks — uploading the onboarding harness results, saw a token/spend spike ~28% in last 24h tied to eval runs.
Maya (CSM): Noted. That's inflating their monthly usage projection; flagging renewal risk if spend doesn't normalize in 6 weeks.
Devon (SRE): Region summary snapshot:
- us-west-2: uptime 99.98%, p99 latency 220ms, error rate 0.2%.
- eu-west-1: uptime 99.2% — observed brief peering flaps, p99 480ms, error rate 1.8%.
- eu-central-1: uptime 99.95%, p99 240ms, error rate 0.15% (fallback target for eu traffic).
- ap-south-1: uptime 99.9%, p99 260ms, error rate 0.4%.
Sam (Eng): For eu-west-1 the peering device logged repeated `TLS renegotiation` warnings at ~03:12 UTC leading to short disconnects. We started routing to eu-central automatically.
Devon (SRE): Confirmed. Networking shows BGP flap tied to a customer appliance firmware bug. Net vendor engaged. Temporary route policy in place (eu -> eu-central) until patch.
Maya (CSM): KMS update? Orion reported two failed key operations during the window.
KMS-Bot: Key alias `orion-prod-key` — state: Degraded. Last rotation attempt failed due to HSM timeout. Retry scheduled +30m. Incident ID KMS-1829.
Sam (Eng): HSM cluster in eu-west-1 returned 504 on rotation. We implemented a hot fallback (soft-wrap) for read operations; write/rotation still hitting the HSM.
Liam (Onboarding): Customer impact: Orion's integration test saw 2 failed API calls; they retried and succeeded. They want a brief note to their infra lead.
Maya (CSM): I'll prepare communication. Also propose a credit if SLA breach >0.5% weekly.
Devon (SRE): Action items (triage list):
1) VPN appliance firmware patch & reboot (owner: Devon) — ETA 6h.
2) Escalate HSM timeout to vendor support (owner: Sam) — ETA 2h for response.
3) Keep eu fallback route in place until stable (Devon) — completed.
4) Run a controlled key rotation test in eu-central as fallback (Sam) — scheduled after vendor ack.
Maya (CSM): Enablement / onboarding asks: schedule 1:1 to review client retry/backoff and token-budgeting with Orion infra team. Liam to coordinate.
Liam (Onboarding): I'll book a 30m slot for tomorrow 10:00 UTC and send a short agenda: reproduction windows, retry recommendations, spend controls.
Sam (Eng): Support bundle uploaded: `s3://redwood-ops/orion/support/1798765432.tar.gz` — contains TLS traces, HSM call traces, and route table snapshots.
Maya (CSM): Good. I'll draft the customer message once Sam confirms vendor response. Will call out mitigations we put in (fallback routing, soft-wrap reads) and expected timeline. :thumbsup:
KMS-Bot: KMS-1829 will auto-close if rotation succeeds on next retry.
Maya (CSM): Closing the thread for now — reopening if any of the action items miss ETA or the customer reports additional failures. Keep updates here.
